description: Bulk add existing or new subscribers to a subscriber list from an email array. Existing subscribers are added to the list without requiring a per-subscriber update call.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

duplicateStrategy.description: Duplicate strategy for existing subscribers: skip, merge, or overwrite. Defaults to skip.

emails.description: Email addresses to add to the list. Maximum 500 per call.

enrollInSequences.description: Whether newly created subscribers should enroll in matching sequences. Defaults to false.

listId.description: Subscriber list ID to add subscribers to.

optInMode.description: Consent mode for newly created subscribers: default, confirmed, or double_opt_in. Defaults to default.

name: add_subscribers_to_list

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `add_subscribers_to_list` MCP tool.

added.description: Number of subscribers added to the list.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

list.description: The list record returned by Sequenzy.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
